parent_objective: materialize a no-rollout current-sim controlled comparison benchmark spec preflight
blocked_by: M2147 must freeze controller matrix, task families, metrics, and claim boundary before preflight implementation
supersedes: direct measured execution without benchmark contract preflight

public_gates: M2148 must write a machine-readable benchmark spec preflight artifact
M2148 must write a profile matrix for the 8 planned controller profiles
M2148 must represent T1-T5 task families and metric support without rollout
M2148 must preserve actor input and action contract guardrails
M2148 must not run reset rollout measured execution or rank controller families
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: materializes the M2147 design into a no-rollout benchmark contract artifact and profile matrix
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: benchmark preflight materialization only; no rollout driver performance ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if preflight requires environment reset
stop if generated-proxy rows are treated as paper evidence
stop if L2 or reset-control profiles are missing
stop if unsupported metrics are silently approximated
stop if actor input guardrails are missing
fallback_plan: route to schema repair if required fields are missing
route to metric-support design if metrics cannot be represented cleanly
route to synthesis if preflight exposes benchmark scope that is too broad

training_stage.stage_objective: current-sim controlled comparison benchmark spec preflight
admission_evidence: M2147 design specifies T1-T5 task families
M2147 design blocks execution and ranking before preflight
blocked_shortcuts: do not run reset in M2148
do not run measured execution in M2148
do not rank controller families in M2148
allowed_updates: benchmark spec preflight implementation if needed
M2148 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for audit or schema repair
next_stage_criteria: next audit or fallback route is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2148 materializes benchmark specs only and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: M2148 must preserve future wrong/delayed/reset/truncated history tests as planned mechanism metrics, but does not execute them.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2147 design and paper-route governing plans.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the benchmark cannot represent fair finite-window and reset controls, record the blocker and repair the spec before any measured execution.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: creates a new benchmark contract artifact instead of extending generated-proxy support diagnostics
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can make current-sim benchmark execution possible but cannot make a verdict by itself
must_synthesize_if: M2148 cannot materialize T1-T5 and L0/L1/L2/L3 controls without broad scope creep
M2148 would require measured execution before schema preflight
M2148 reveals that required metrics are mostly unsupported

hypothesis: The M2147 current-sim benchmark design can be materialized into a no-rollout spec preflight with explicit profile matrix, task families, metric support, and claim boundaries.
success_criteria: profile matrix includes all 8 planned profiles
no reset rollout measured execution ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: ranking or paper-level claims are made

commands.name: preflight
commands.command: materialize no-rollout benchmark spec preflight artifacts from the M2147 design

decision_rule: M2148 passes if it writes complete no-rollout benchmark spec and profile-matrix artifacts with explicit claim boundaries.
